name: Course Sync
description: A serverless course synchronization CLI for instructors and students using \textbf{Go}, \textbf{Cobra}, \textbf{Git}, and \textbf{JSON}-backed repositories. Engineered a \textbf{layered architecture} with domain services, CLI workflows, and atomic local persistence to manage assignments, document releases, and student records without central infrastructure. Features include role-based sync commands, automated distribution of course materials, and \textbf{content-hash-based submission tracking} for reproducible assignment handins. (Repository: \href{https://github.com/TypingHare/course-sync}{https://github.com/TypingHare/course-sync})

name: BG Clock
description: A responsive touchscreen clock application for board games like Chess and Go using \textbf{Vite}, \textbf{React}, \textbf{Chakra UI}, and \textbf{TypeScript}. Engineered a \textbf{modular game core} with a precise game loop and extensible trigger system for accurate timekeeping and flexible mode support. Features include customizable timers, sound alerts, and multimode gameplay. (Live Demo: \href{https://bgc.jameschen.life}{https://bgc.jameschen.life})
